title: Workbench
intro: Tools I built for myself. They're how I work.

items.name: Phil
items.line: Living project files: Claude Code hooks keep a readable status for each project and bring it back at the start of every new session.
items.howItWorks: Every project is a living file. Claude Code hooks read each session, Claude Haiku updates what's done, decided and waiting, and the file comes back at the start of the next session. When a session isn't linked to a project, Claude asks which one.

image.alt: Phil's dashboard: who is waiting on what on the left, the living project files on the right

items.name: gbrain
items.line: My second brain: a Postgres and pgvector knowledge base of everything I work on, synced every day, that my agents search first.
items.howItWorks: Everything I work on lands in one knowledge base: project files, meeting notes, voice notes. A routine syncs it every morning and my agents search it before they answer, so they start with context instead of from zero.

image.alt: gbrain in Obsidian's graph view: grey nodes on a dark background

items.name: nest
items.line: My Paris apartment hunt on autopilot: listings scored on 24 weighted criteria, a phone alert above 70, scam checks built in.
items.howItWorks: It reads new listings and agency emails, scores each one on 24 weighted criteria (the commute is the only deal breaker), checks for scams, and sends a phone alert with action buttons when a place scores above 70.

image.alt: nest alert on my phone: a studio scored 73/100, with the commute

items.name: Tiroflan
items.line: A macOS menu bar app that logs freelance hours and keeps two Macs in sync through Google Calendar.
items.howItWorks: Start a timer per client from the menu bar. Every session becomes a calendar event, and each Mac rereads the calendar every minute, so my work Mac and my personal Mac stay in sync without a server.

image.alt: Tiroflan open: timer, logged hours and activity

items.name: Security watch
items.line: A daily security report on my 34 repos: safe fixes merge themselves, only when the build is green.
items.howItWorks: Every morning a script reads the Dependabot alerts on my 34 repos and sends a report to my phone. Security fixes merge on their own only when the Vercel build is green; everything else waits for me.
